text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card (15.9% vs 2.6%, 239 claims, z 2.16, 61% low complexity, 4 documented 99215 with 0 below billed, 5 of 18 data without tests). But the headline 'all 30 random charts support the billed level' overstates: only 4 of the 30 were 99215 and the summary itself says few 99215 charts. The cited claims C0091671 and C0091678 are real low-complexity 99215 claims, but no documentation exists for them, so they support only the complexity point. Only two of 22 low-complexity claims are shown. The 'Mild note signals (13% duplicate...)' line is inconsistent with the earlier note-check list, which has no duplicate figure. Several note-signal numbers and the 7% peer comparison do not appear on the card and are not shown in the tool outputs excerpt. The missing results deficiency is not flagged, nor is the lack of an audit trail beyond a short mention.
